name: Caribbean Callaloo and Beans
ingredients: 200 g spinach or amaranth leaves, chopped
¾ cup cooked red kidney beans
1 small onion and 2 garlic cloves, chopped
2 spring onions and 1 sprig fresh thyme
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion, garlic and spring onions for 4 minutes.
Add the okra, thyme, whole chilli and stock and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the greens and beans and simmer for 8 minutes until the greens collapse.
Stir in the coconut milk, remove the chilli, and season.
note: Callaloo is a leafy green stew; amaranth leaves are the closest authentic option if available.
